title: Token-level time-series store + delta heatmap UI and anomaly clustering triage flow
creator: Priya Das
description: Build a persistent store and visualization flow for token-level benchmark time-series so we can reliably surface regressions across model versions, sequence-length slices, and traffic patterns. This ticket covers: 1) ingest schema and compact storage for per-request token timings (start, per-token delta) with retention policy, 2) a delta-heatmap UI that compares two selected baselines (versions/commits/dates) across sequence length and prompt archetypes, and 3) an anomaly clustering and triage workflow that groups regressions, assigns severity, and creates GitHub issues or rerun jobs automatically.
acceptance_criteria: A compact time-series schema stored in benchmark DB that can represent per-request per-token latencies and metadata (model, version, seq_len, prompt_tag, region)
API to ingest and query aggregates (p50/p95/p99/tokens_per_sec) over arbitrary time windows and sequence-length buckets
Delta-heatmap UI prototype showing per-bucket p95 deltas between two snapshots and hover drilldowns down to the example requests
Auto-clustering algorithm groups related anomalies (same prompt archetype / same model variant / same infra lane) and surfaces a prioritized triage list
Automated triage actions: link to failing benchmark run, suggest rerun command, optionally create GitHub issue with reproducible runner script
End-to-end test that reproduces a synthetic regression and verifies it's surfaced in the UI and produces a triage item
comments: 2025-11-06 Miguel: Spike complete — prototype schema stores per-token deltas as 16-bit microsecond buckets, reduces storage by ~6x vs naive approach. Next: add efficient percentile sketches for p95 queries.

2025-11-07 Priya: PM review — prioritize sequence-length slicing and prompt_tag dimension; customers frequently hit high-seq tails. Add label 'customer-impact-high' when anomaly affects production traffic tag.
2025-11-08 Design (Aisha): Heatmap rows=sequence length buckets, cols=prompt archetypes. Color is relative p95 delta. Need explainer tooltip and quick-link to rerun harness for that cell.

2025-11-10 Eng review: Decided to store base aggregates (counts, streaming TDigest) and a sample reservoir of raw per-request traces for hotspots to keep storage bounded. Trade-off: sampling may miss ultra-rare regressions; mitigated by on-demand rerun with deterministic seed.

2025-11-11 Miguel: Implemented clusterer prototype (HDBSCAN) on latency deltas; initial runs group ~88% of anomalies into 6 meaningful clusters for internal bench dataset. Still tuning noise threshold.
2025-11-12 QA: Found UX bug where heatmap color legend didn't update after switching baseline snapshots — filed small follow-up PR to UI repo.
notes: Implementation should be compatible with both hosted and dedicated testbeds (k8s and dedicated GPU pools). Coordinate with infra team about retention and index costs. Consider adding an opt-in encrypted blob for raw traces when running on Private customers to satisfy data controls.
outstanding_risks: Sampling strategy could hide rare regressions; storage cost for high-cardinality prompt_tag + region combinations could grow quickly. Need quota and pruning policies before GA.
next_steps: Finalize storage schema and write migration for existing legacy benchmark store
Finish UI heatmap interaction (baseline selector, hover drilldown, rerun link)
Hook clusterer outputs into triage automation to create GitHub issues for P0/P1 regressions
Add telemetry for how often triage items are auto-created vs manually promoted
